The modifications across the files are interconnected as they all aim to replace direct calls to `drm_sched_wqueue_ready` with the newly introduced `amdgpu_ring_sched_ready` function. This change centralizes the logic for checking the readiness of the scheduler into a single function, improving code maintainability and readability.
